human_somite_organoid_specimen.species: Vertebrate paraxial mesoderm / somite embryo dorsal SEM (transferred as structural reference for human pluripotent stem-cell somite organoid / axioloid metameric somite periodicity)

hes7_delayed_oscillator_governing_equati.section: Diaz-Cuadros et al. (2020) Nature 580:113-118; Matsuda et al. (2020) Science 369:1450-1455; Diaz-Cuadros et al. (2023) Nature 613:550-557
hes7_delayed_oscillator_governing_equati.mrna_dde: dm/dt = alpha_m / (1 + (p(t - tau_tx) / K)^n) - delta_m * m(t)
hes7_delayed_oscillator_governing_equati.protein_dde: dp/dt = alpha_p * m(t - tau_tl) - delta_p * p(t)
hes7_delayed_oscillator_governing_equati.half_life_degradation_relation: delta_m = ln(2) / t_half_m,  delta_p = ln(2) / t_half_p
hes7_delayed_oscillator_governing_equati.exact_time_rescaling_invariance_law: Under t -> lambda * t, tau -> lambda * tau, delta_m -> delta_m / lambda, delta_p -> delta_p / lambda, alpha_m -> alpha_m / lambda, alpha_p -> alpha_p / lambda, the HES7 DDE is strictly invariant and oscillation period scales as T_osc(lambda) = lambda * T_osc(1) with lambda_human_mouse = 300 / 120 = 2.50
hes7_delayed_oscillator_governing_equati.metabolic_nad_nadh_scaling_law: k_met(R_NAD) = (R_NAD / R_NAD_ref)^gamma_met,  delta_m,p(R_NAD) = k_met * delta_m,p_0,  tau(R_NAD) = tau_0 / k_met  =>  T_osc(R_NAD) = T_osc_0 / k_met(R_NAD)

mouse_wt.species: Mus musculus (in vitro PSM / iPSC-derived presomitic mesoderm)

human_wt.species: Homo sapiens (hPSC-derived PSM / HES7-Achilles reporter & Axioloid)

matsuda_diazcuadros_perturbation_series.source: Matsuda et al. (2020) Science 369:1450-1455 Figs. 1-4; Diaz-Cuadros et al. (2020) Nature 580:113-118 Figs. 2-4; Diaz-Cuadros et al. (2023) Nature 613:550-557 Figs. 1-4

regimes.label: Mouse PSM + human hHES7 locus knock-in swap (Matsuda 2020 Fig. 2)
Human PSM + LbNOX expression (elevated cytosolic NAD+/NADH accelerates translation, Diaz-Cuadros 2023 Fig. 4)
Human PSM + Sodium Azide / Rotenone Complex I/IV ETC inhibition (Diaz-Cuadros 2023 Fig. 2)
Intronless Hes7 Delta-intron1-3 ablation (tau_splicing = 0 -> subcritical delay collapse, Matsuda 2020 / Takashima 2011)

vertebrate_segmentation_clock_allometry.source: Diaz-Cuadros et al. (2020) Nature 580:113-118; Matsuda et al. (2020) Science 369:1450-1455; Lázaro et al. (2023) Nature Ecology & Evolution 7:1107-1118

notch_coupled_hexagonal_lattice_dapt_was.section: Pass 3 (Law 4 diaza-human-somite-organoid-clock-4). Lewis (2003); Riedel-Kruse et al. (2007); Herrgen et al. (2010); Matsuda et al. (2020) Nature 580:124-129; Diaz-Cuadros et al. (2020)

lattice.type: odd-r offset hexagonal, non-periodic tissue boundary

coupling_equations.notch_activation: S_i(t) = D_bar_i(t - tau_c)^h / (K_D^h + D_bar_i(t - tau_c)^h),  h = 2,  K_D = <D> over one single-cell cycle
coupling_equations.hes7_mrna_dde: dm_i/dt = alpha_m * gate_i / (1 + (p_i(t - tau_tx,i) / (K * gate_i))^n) - delta_m,i * m_i,  gate_i = (1 - eps) + 2 eps S_i
coupling_equations.dll1_dde: dD_i/dt = alpha_D / (1 + (p_i(t - tau_tx,i) / K)^n) - delta_D,i * D_i,  alpha_D = alpha_m,  t_half_D = 1.5 t_half_p
coupling_equations.dapt: gamma-secretase block: NICD absent, gate_i = b = 0.10 (Notch-independent basal HES7 promoter activity) -> oscillation collapse
coupling_equations.mean_field_reduction: homogeneous in-phase state: D_bar_i = D_i, lattice == single self-coupled DDE (Lean theorem lewis_herrgen_notch_coupling_mean_field_dapt_gating)

in_phase_stability_scan.method: 8x8 lattice started synchronised, 5 % tempo CV, R after 6 cycles >= 0.85
in_phase_stability_scan.note: delayed coupling theory (Morelli 2009 / Herrgen 2010): in-phase stability depends on tau_c / T; tau_c has not been measured in human PSM and is assumed to scale with species tempo

dapt_washout_synchronisation.observation: a DAPT pulse followed by washout synchronises HES7 oscillations across the hPSC-derived PSM culture (qualitative anchor; R = 1 ideal)

notch_inhibition_desynchronisation.observation: Notch inhibition (DAPT) desynchronises neighbouring segmentation clock cells; synchrony recovers after washout over several cycles (zebrafish)

coupling_delay_period.observation: intercellular coupling with delay tau_c modulates the collective period relative to the cell-autonomous period (zebrafish, tau_c ~ 21 min for T ~ 30 min)

matrigel_embedded_rosette_mechanics.section: Pass 3 (Law 5 diaza-human-somite-organoid-clock-5). Yamanaka et al. (2023) Nature 614:509-520; Sanaki-Matsumiya et al. (2022) Nat Commun 13:2325
matrigel_embedded_rosette_mechanics.model: reduced 2D overdamped cell-centre model of one axioloid somite cross-section (24 cells, r_c = 6 um) inside an elastic Matrigel shell (R_M = 28 um); not a 3D FEM

forces.matrigel_boundary: F_M,i = -kappa * phi * max(0, |x_i - c| - R_M) * r_hat_i,  kappa = 0.01 min^-1 per %
forces.ecm_polarity_cue: d n_i/dt ∝ rho_pol * f(phi) * contact_i * (-r_hat_i - n_i),  f(phi) = phi^2 / (phi^2 + 4^2)
forces.epithelialisation: d e_i/dt = k_epi f(phi) contact_i (1 - e_i) + junctional spread - k_de e_i
forces.apical_constriction: F_ac,i = -k_ac * sum_j e_i e_j (a_i - a_j),  a_i = x_i + r_c n_i
forces.cell_cell: soft-disc repulsion (d < 2 r_c) and cadherin adhesion (2 r_c <= d < 2.8 r_c); mesenchymal motility ∝ (1 - e_i)

matrigel_required.observation: axioloids embedded in 10 % Matrigel (with retinoic acid) form epithelial somites with apical-basal polarity; non-embedded aggregates do not epithelialise (qualitative; no published rosette order parameter)

somitoid_epithelial_somites.observation: Matrigel-embedded human somitoids form periodic epithelial somites

caveats: kappa (Matrigel stiffness per %) is not calibrated to rheological measurements of Matrigel
polarisation and constriction rate constants are phenomenological
